verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents documents running agents in 70+ languages, with language-specific voice settings and voices across 31 languages, so multilingual conversations are a first-party capability. However, the pack never documents automatic language detection or switching the conversation language mid-call; the only switching evidence covers changing voices (e.g., for language tutoring), not detecting the caller's language. Missing for 10: documented automatic language detection, documented mid-call language switching, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run conversations in multiple languages, including detecting and switching language mid-call

citations.quote: Configure, deploy and monitor natural, human-sounding agents in 70+ languages with leading accuracy and ultra-low latency across voice or chat.
Select from 5k+ voices across 31 languages with customization options
This includes controlling pronunciation, speaking speed, and language-specific voice settings.
Enable your agent to switch between different voices for multi-character conversations, storytelling, and language tutoring
